strategies.name: workflow-type-clustering
strategies.description: Group observed sessions by their workflow type (inferred from PR labels and branch names) to identify recurrence patterns, session volume per type, and cross-type performance differences.
strategies.findings: 4 distinct workflow types found. Docs-related workflows (docs-consolidator, instructions-janitor) run daily in pairs. train-drain3-weights runs daily. docs-unbloat appears triggered less frequently. go-logger is feature-driven (once).
